jobs.title: Part Time Sales Assistant & Client Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Part Time Sales Assistant \& Client Onboarding Specialist**

We are a Boca Raton, Florida\-based submetering and utility billing company providing turn\-key water meter installation and ongoing tenant billing services to commercial properties.

We are seeking a highly organized, fast\-moving Remote Sales Assistant \& Client Onboarding Specialist based in the Sarasota/Venice, FL area to support our U.S. sales pipeline and coordinate the transition of newly closed accounts into onboarding and billing. We welcome applicants from a range of sales and sales support backgrounds and we are happy to train the right person who brings strong analytical skills, client focus, organization, and a willingness to learn.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales Pipeline Coordination (Lead Gen to Closing)**

· **Review incoming lead and property data**, including property size, unit counts, and location, to ensure required information is complete before the closer’s introductory call.

· **Monitor and maintain the CRM sales pipeline**, ensuring leads do not stall, follow\-up activities are scheduled, and notes, client needs, meeting action items, and next steps are accurately documented.

· **Assist with proposal preparation and revisions** by gathering estimator information, verifying proposals align with client needs, double\-checking details, and making minor approved adjustments when necessary.

**Client Onboarding \& Account Setup**

* **Serve as the internal client data coordinator for new property implementations**, coordinating across Sales, Operations, Warehouse, Metering, Contracts, and Billing to ensure each team has the required information, materials, and documentation.
* **Monitor project status and established timelines**, proactively identifying delays or obstacles, following up with appropriate team members, communicating updates to Sales and clients, and escalating issues that could affect billing commencement or the client experience.

**Administrative Support**

* **Coordinate COI, W\-9, and other administrative document requests** with personnel in the Boca Raton office.

· **Coordinate billing agreements**, including collecting required information, providing agreements to clients for execution, and following up to prevent delays in billing activation.

**Working Hours \& Location Constraints**

· **Location \& Hours:** Remote, strictly based in Sarasota/Venice area of Florida, with partial or full shift alignment with U.S. Eastern Time (ET) to support real\-time collaboration with the Florida home office, lead generation teams, and U.S.\-based closers.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience \& Pipeline Management:** 2\+ years in sales coordination, sales administration, client onboarding, or customer success. B2B sales pipeline experience is highly preferred, along with familiarity managing CRM stages from Qualified to Closed\-Won
* **Language Proficiency:** Exceptional professional **verbal and written English skills** are required for direct communication with U.S. property managers, clients, and internal corporate teams.
* **Data Accuracy \& Organization:** Exceptional attention to detail with numeric data, spreadsheets, and multi\-unit property layouts, with the ability to manage multiple projects, identify outstanding items, follow up consistently, and keep projects progressing within established timelines.
* **Independent Execution:** Proven ability to work autonomously, prioritize responsibilities, solve problems proactively, and maintain high productivity in a remote environment.

Pay: $39,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Pharmacy Automation Customer Success & Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

Self\-motivated and driven to succeed, and to help Noritsu customers to succeed. As a Customer Success Manager for Noritsu Pharmacy Automation, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the satisfaction and success of our pharmacy automation clients. Your primary responsibility will be to build strong relationships with our customers, understand their unique needs, and guide them in leveraging our automation solutions effectively. We believe that customer success begins with training. You will have primary responsibility from customer skill development from install to full production.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

· Coordinate with local teams to provide on\-site skill development and education on the use of the equipment.

· Assist sales team in identifying business opportunities and prospects evaluating their pharmacy listening to the concerns/problems to identify possible solutions which result in purchase decisions

· Build networks and spheres of influence in order to grow prospect lists

· Maintain relationships with clients by providing support, information, and guidance; research and recommend new opportunities; recommend profit and service improvements

· Participate in events and conferences on behalf of the company

· Train operators of pharmacy automation systems.

· Assist in the development of pharmacy training tools. Lead courses, webinars, and provide onsite training.

· Conduct product demonstrations and implementation consultations in conjunction with the Sales team.

· Work closely with Sales Managers, Technical Supervisors, and the Operations Department during the implementation phase of equipment.

· Conduct follow\-up evaluations with pharmacies after installations.

· Update job knowledge by participating in classes provided by Noritsu and other manufacturers, in addition to reading professional publications and participating in online training programs.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and /or ability required.

·**Education / Experience:**

o Minimum of a High School diploma and at least three years experience in a pharmacy setting.

o PTCB certification is a plus.

· **Knowledge, Skills and/or Abilities:**

o Must have excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills

o Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills with a strong command of the English language.

o Previous experience in a customer\-facing role, preferably in the healthcare or pharmaceutical industry.

o Familiarity with pharmacy operations and automation technology is highly desirable.

o Must have strong presentation skills to customers, supply partners, and employees in one\-on\-one and group settings

o Must have the ability to convey and clearly explain customer requirements to technical personnel

o Must have a valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

o Must be willing and able to travel over 80% of the time.

o Must be willing and able to work overtime.

o Must be comfortable with and able to perform in a professional/medical office type of environment.

**Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to walk distances of up to ½ mile; climb up/down up to three flights of stairs; sit; kneel; stoop; bend; stretch; climb ladders; stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee must be able to lift up to waist level 20 pounds and carry it for up to 15 feet. The employee must be able to lift up to head level 10 pounds. The employee must be able to drive up to six hours in a day and/or travel by airplane. The employee must be able to access, enter, and retrieve data using a computer. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Indianapolis, IN 46227

* Collaborating with clients and Solventum team members to deploy and configure Solventum products by completing project deliverables and serving implementation needs.

*

* *Bachelor’s Degree or higher from an accredited university And Four (4\) of experience.*

*OR*

* *High School Diploma/GED AND a minimum of Eighth (8\)years of experience.*

  

AND


In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:


* *Minimum of three (3\) combined years direct experience with support of software and/or implementation of software (preferably in a healthcare setting supporting Solventum™ 360 Encompass™).*
* *Minimum of two (2\) combined years of working knowledge of hospital and/or professional healthcare coding workflow.*
* *Minimum of two (2\) year' experience in a client facing implementation role.*

* Knowledge of 3M/Solventum™ 360 Encompass™ Professional products.
* Electronic Medical Record implementation experience.
* Ability to solve problems in a logical, methodical, and time efficient manner.
* Must be self\-starter with ability to analyze and critically think. Excellent problem solving and organizational skills.

* Strong written/verbal communication skills and must be capable of maintaining superior customer relations in a fast\-paced environment.
Ability to quickly learn and apply new tools and technology.

jobs.description:

At Wipfli, our people are core to everything we do—the catalyst behind our ability to create exceptional impact and extraordinary results.

  


We believe in flexibility. We focus on relationships. We encourage each individual to follow their own path.

  


People truly matter and they feel it. For those looking to make a difference and find a professional home, Wipfli offers a career\-defining opportunity.

  


**Job Summary**


Under the direction of a Manager, or Senior Manager/Director, the Senior Consultant will develop and provide solutions for clients pursuing operational excellence and/or technical solutions. The Senior Sage Intacct Implementation Consultant will play a key role in our national\-based client support with both small and large scale implementations.


**Essential Responsibilities:**


* Prioritizes, leads, and participates in efforts to ensure the team keeps pace in the evolution of technology and consulting including AI, systems, and trends.
* Provides direction, feedback, and leadership in an environment of rapid change.
* Leads continuous improvement initiatives within the organization by identifying areas for enhancement, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and implementing strategies to enhance overall performance.
* Proposes tailored solutions that are linked to client business needs.
* Collects and analyzes relevant data, conducts client interviews, prepares workpapers and reports, and serves as lead subject matter expert on projects.
* Plays a pivotal role in designing and configuring accounting systems, working in collaboration with accounting and IT client leadership to establish robust systems that streamline financial processes, maintain data integrity, and support compliance.
* Generates comprehensive financial and operational reports by analyzing data, synthesizing information, and presenting key insights to stakeholders. Collaborate closely with finance, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure accurate and timely reporting.
* Organizes, establishes, and monitors progress on project work plans to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. Escalates issues with timeline, scope and budget to engagement manager and/or industry leader.
* Serves as a lead in services and business development maturity including asset and methodology design and upkeep.
* Trains, mentors and/or serves as performance coach to Consultant I’s and Consultant II’s. Delegates and leverages work to ensure staff development.
* Perform emergency on\-site or remote support as needed.


**Required Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s Degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5\+ years’ experience in a professional services firm or 5\+ years of private industry experience focused on the financial and/or accounting space.
* Implementation experience with Sage Intacct (experience with an equivalent Cloud\-based technology may also be considered).
* Openly discusses real or potential problems with clients or project team members, listening, comprehending, confirming, and representing client requirements with various levels of stakeholder.

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s Degree in related field
* Training, support or consulting advisory experience.
* Experience with compliance or professional standards associated with area of expertise.

Alaina Lister, from our recruiting team, will be guiding you through this process. Visit her LinkedIn page to connect!

jobs.title: HCAI - HEALTH INFORMATION AND ELECTRONIC RECORDS ANALYST TRAINING PROGRAM (EHR SUPPORT INTERNSHIP)
jobs.description:
Description: **\*\*\*Eligible Applicants must be residents of California. \*\*\*****Next Cohorts Begin: 11/17/2026**  

**\*\*PLEASE NOTE: "This is a grant\-funded training program, not an employment opportunity" Employment is not guaranteed at the completion of the program\*\***  

**Selection for participation in the training program is NOT guaranteed.** **Applying** **or** **being referred** **to apply does NOT guarantee acceptance, as participation is subject to HCAI enrollment guidelines.****Description:**


The Health Information and EHR Systems Analyst program (HIER) prepares students to manage healthcare data and electronic health record (EHR) systems with confidence. Learners receive hands\-on training in EPIC, SQL, Tableau, and Crystal Reports, building core competencies in clinical data management, system implementation, and reporting. ***The program also introduces participants to technical workflows aligned with the EHR Support Analyst (ESA) role, including Epic optimization, system troubleshooting, and internal user support.*** This expanded focus equips learners to contribute to healthcare IT environments through both foundational and system\-facing responsibilities, ensuring data accuracy, security, and compliance.

***This program prepares students for the HIMSS CAHIMS certification, providing a strong pathway into health information technology and EHR specialist roles across healthcare settings.***

**Note: The EHR Support Analyst (ESA) plays a key role in helping healthcare teams use electronic health record (EHR)**


This program consists of online classroom training and a remote hands\-on internship/externship. Participation in both components require a commitment of 40 hours per week during standard business hours.

**Note: This program consists of 2 Phases:**

**1\. Online classroom training (approximately 20 weeks)**

**2\. Online Internship (approximately 19 weeks)**

**Participation in all components above is required and require a commitment of 40 hours per week during standard business hours. The entire program as a whole is approximately 39\-44 weeks in duration.**

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* **Applicants must be residents of California.**
* Must be 18 years or older
* Must have a high school diploma or GED certification
* Must be a U.S. Citizen/National or have a valid Lawful Permanent Resident Alien (not open to non\-citizens or Visa holders)
* Must have proficient computer experience (MS Windows \& MS Suite (Word, Excel, PP, Outlook)
* Ability to type Net 40 wpm
* **Great attention to detail and strict HIPAA compliance**
* **Analytical and detail oriented.**
* **Able to learn in a self\-directed, fast\-paced, rapidly changing environment.**

**Program Details:**

* ***Schedule:*** The training program runs Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and includes a living stipend.
* ***Commitment:*** The program includes remote learning and remote hands\-on internship/externship training. Accepted participants must complete 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, during regular business hours for the entire duration of the program.
* ***Compensation*****:** $31,200, This stipend is distributed over approximately 44 weeks for participation in both remote learning and remote hands\-on internship/ externship training. Stipend payment is made on OCHIN’s semi\-monthly pay schedule.
* ***Benefits:*** Eligible for monthly benefits reimbursement of up to $600 (participant cost only). Some restrictions apply. Also, Internet Stipend $35/month for 44 weeks
* ***Attendance Policy:***Participants are not eligible to receive paid holidays or paid time off (PTO), all missed time will need to be made up.

**Program Objectives:**

* Learn to apply specialized health care and database management insights to analyze important clinical data, identify trends, and create targeted reports.
* Develop expertise in managing health information and EHR systems to support healthcare organizations.
* Apply data management skills using tools such as EPIC, SQL, Tableau, and Crystal Reports to analyze and report clinical data.
* Understand and implement system design, testing, and security protocols to ensure data privacy and compliance.
* Prepare for the HIMSS CAHIMS certification exam, focusing on healthcare IT, leadership, and system analysis.
* Support healthcare teams in optimizing operational workflows and improving patient outcomes through technology


Requirements:

The ***EHR Support Analyst (ESA)*** plays a key role in helping healthcare teams use electronic health record (EHR) systems efficiently and accurately. ESAs monitor system alerts, resolve technical issues, and support staff with tools like Epic to ensure patient data flows smoothly across departments. They help maintain user access, troubleshoot application errors, and guide clinical teams through system updates and workflow changes.


This role requires attention to detail, strong communication skills, and a commitment to improving how health information is managed. ESAs contribute to better patient care by making sure the technology behind the scenes works reliably, securely, and in alignment with clinical needs.

**The ESA duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Review communications from OCHIN and internal teams via email and Jira to stay informed of system updates and notifications.
* Relay system notifications and updates to appropriate end users to ensure timely awareness and action.
* Troubleshoot Epic\-related issues in collaboration with end users and support teams, using Jira and other designated channels.
* Monitor and manage Epic workqueues including Interface Errors, EMR Errors, E\-Prescribing Errors, Failed Fax, Charge Router Errors, and Claim Edits.
* Monitor and respond to internal help requests and departed provider pools to support data integrity and workflow continuity.
* Attach to and monitor the Default Provider In Basket to ensure timely resolution of outstanding items.
* Review and process scanning and indexing issues, including training end users on redaction procedures.
* Update and maintain user records (EMPs, SERs, Ella access) and system configurations to support accurate access and functionality.
* Build and inactivate user access as needed, following onboarding and offboarding protocols.
* Update Fee Schedules, Preference Lists, SmartPhrases, and SmartLists to reflect current workflows and provider needs.
* Request destination map updates and maintain Lot Manager to support accurate routing and inventory tracking.
* Assist users in optimizing their Epic experience through personalized support and workflow enhancements.
* Review Weekly Change Notices and update training documentation and workflows accordingly.
* Implement internal trainings on Epic functionality and system updates to support staff development.
* Create and modify letter templates to support communication and documentation needs.
* Assess existing workflows and contribute to the development of more efficient processes based on operational needs.
* Run and review system reports such as Open Encounter Reports and Duplicate Patient Reports.
* Maintain the security and integrity of health information by adhering to privacy policies and regulatory standards.
* Other duties as assigned.

**OCHIN Workforce Development Equal Opportunity Statement**

*OCHIN is an equal opportunity educational provider committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable environment for all. We are dedicated to a policy of non\-discrimination for all members of the OCHIN community, including learners, team members, and applicants. We do not discriminate based on race, creed, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.*

*OCHIN is committed to making decisions for program entry, training, and educational opportunities based on individual qualifications and abilities. We actively seek to attract learners and team members from diverse backgrounds and affirmatively support equal access and opportunity for women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, special disabled veterans, and other covered veterans, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.*

*We strive to create an inclusive learning environment that fosters the success of every individual and reflects the diverse communities we serve.*

**OCHIN Workforce Development Health Screenings and Immunization Requirements**

*To ensure the safety of our learners, partners, and communities, OCHIN requires all program participants—including those attending remote and in\-person training, internships, and externships—to be vaccinated with a COVID\-19 vaccine, as recommended by state and federal public health officials. Participants must provide proof of full vaccination or receive approval for a medical or religious exemption prior to program acceptance.*

*Additionally, for on\-site internships and externships, participants must provide proof of meeting the immunization requirements specific to the host site prior to acceptance into the program. These requirements may include, but are not limited to, vaccinations for influenza, hepatitis B, and MMR. Requests for exemptions based on medical or religious grounds will be reviewed and must comply with applicable laws and site\-specific policies.*

*Please note that many sites require participants to complete tuberculosis (Tb) testing and drug screening before beginning their placement. Participants are responsible for ensuring that all required health screenings are completed by the site’s deadline to avoid delays in program participation.*

*OCHIN is committed to working collaboratively with program participants and host sites to ensure compliance with these health and safety requirements while maintaining respect for individual beliefs and circumstances.*

jobs.title: EHR Training & Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Ezderm**

Ezderm is a high\-growth healthcare technology company dedicated to modernizing the dermatology experience. We build intuitive, cloud\-based electronic health records (EHR) and practice management solutions that empower providers to focus on what matters most: patient care. Driven by innovation and a culture of resilience, we bridge the gap between complex medical workflows and seamless digital efficiency. At Ezderm, we don’t just provide software; we build the foundational tools that help dermatology practices thrive and scale in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

**Summary/Objective:**

The Client Success Specialist is responsible for delivering exceptional onboarding, training, and ongoing support to Ezderm's dermatology practice clients. In this role, you will serve as a trusted product expert — helping practices get the most out of Ezderm's EHR and Practice Management platform through hands\-on training, responsive issue resolution, and proactive engagement. The ideal candidate brings healthcare IT experience, a consultative mindset, and the ability to build strong relationships with both clinical and administrative teams in a fast\-paced, client\-facing environment.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Client Training \& Onboarding:** Serve as an Ezderm product expert and deliver engaging, role\-specific training for new and existing clients across our full software suite — EHR, Practice Management, Patient Portal, and third\-party integrations. Partner with the Implementation team to support smooth practice onboarding and ensure clients are set up for long\-term success.
* **Support \& Issue Resolution:** Provide responsive, high\-quality support to clients via phone, email, and our online community. Diagnose and resolve software issues efficiently, communicate solutions clearly, and escalate complex cases with full context and documentation.
* **Product Expertise \& Feedback Loop:** Maintain deep, current knowledge of Ezderm's features, workflows, and updates. Proactively identify recurring client pain points and share structured feedback with Product and Engineering to inform roadmap decisions.
* **Content \& Community:** Contribute to the development and maintenance of support resources, including knowledge base articles, how\-to guides, and tutorial videos. Engage actively in the Ezderm community to answer questions, surface trends, and foster a positive user experience.
* **Dermatology Domain Knowledge:** Build and apply a working understanding of dermatology workflows, terminology, common procedures, and medications to communicate credibly with clinical and administrative staff.
* **Documentation \& CRM Hygiene:** Maintain accurate, timely records of all client interactions, support cases, and onboarding activities in our CRM. Ensure documentation supports visibility across the Customer Success team.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support Ezderm's client success.

**Qualifications:**

* 2\+ years of experience in healthcare provider operations, practice management, or the EHR/health IT industry required
* Prior experience in a dermatology practice or with an EHR software company strongly preferred
* Bachelor's degree preferred

**Knowledge, Skills \& Characteristics:**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; ability to diagnose issues systematically and communicate solutions clearly
* Exceptional customer service orientation with a consultative, patient\-centered approach
* Ability to manage multiple client engagements and shifting priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; comfortable presenting to both clinical and administrative audiences
* Proficiency with software platforms and general systems; ability to quickly learn and navigate new tools
* Ability to travel domestically up to 50% of the time

Join us as an EHR Training \& Implementation Specialist and be instrumental in transforming how dermatology practices leverage technology! Your expertise will empower providers to deliver better patient care while streamlining their operations through innovative digital solutions.

**Equal Opportunity \& Our Commitment**

At Ezderm, we celebrate the unique perspectives our team members bring and are committed to maintaining an inclusive environment free from discrimination or harassment. We provide equal opportunities for employment and growth based solely on qualifications and merit, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Please note that Ezderm is an at\-will employer. This job description is not a comprehensive list of duties, which may evolve or be assigned at any time as we continue to grow and scale.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Parental leave
* Retirement plan

Experience:

* EHR systems: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: Remote

*We strive to create an inclusive learning environment that fosters the success of every individual and reflects the diverse communities we serve.*

**OCHIN Workforce Development Health Screenings and Immunization Requirements**

*To ensure the safety of our learners, partners, and communities, OCHIN requires all program participants—including those attending remote and in\-person training, internships, and externships—to be vaccinated with a COVID\-19 vaccine, as recommended by state and federal public health officials. Participants must provide proof of full vaccination or receive approval for a medical or religious exemption prior to program acceptance.*

*Additionally, for on\-site internships and externships, participants must provide proof of meeting the immunization requirements specific to the host site prior to acceptance into the program. These requirements may include, but are not limited to, vaccinations for influenza, hepatitis B, and MMR. Requests for exemptions based on medical or religious grounds will be reviewed and must comply with applicable laws and site\-specific policies.*

*Please note that many sites require participants to complete tuberculosis (Tb) testing and drug screening before beginning their placement. Participants are responsible for ensuring that all required health screenings are completed by the site’s deadline to avoid delays in program participation.*

*OCHIN is committed to working collaboratively with program participants and host sites to ensure compliance with these health and safety requirements while maintaining respect for individual beliefs and circumstances.*

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** EHR Analyst, Senior  

**Department:** Ambulatory Application  

**Location:** Riedman \- Remote  

**Hours Per Week:** 40  

**Schedule:** Full\-Time, Day\-Shift, Monday to Friday, (8 am \- 4:00 pm)

 **POSITION SUMMARY:**  

The EHR Application Analyst Senior serves as an advanced\-level contributor in the support, optimization, and ongoing development of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role handles complex technical issues, leads system optimization efforts, and serves as a resource and mentor for junior analysts. The EHR Application Analyst Senior applies deep knowledge of EHR capabilities and healthcare business workflows to drive improvements that enhance clinical and operational performance.  

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Advanced System Support and Maintenance:
* Serve as a primary escalation point for complex technical issues and system errors, applying advanced troubleshooting techniques to ensure timely resolution and minimal disruption to patient care.
* Provide day\-to\-day technical support to end\-users, including troubleshooting issues, answering questions, and resolving system errors to ensure uninterrupted use of the EHR system.
* Provide guidance to junior analysts on day\-to\-day support challenges, sharing expertise and building team capability.
* Lead and coordinate routine maintenance activities, including software updates, patches, and upgrades, to ensure the stability and security of the EHR system.
* Coordinate testing and validation activities for system changes, enhancements, and upgrades, ensuring new features meet functional requirements without introducing unintended disruptions.
* Participate in on\-call rotations, including taking lead responsibility for after\-hours coverage on complex or escalated issues.


System Optimization:

* Lead efforts to optimize the performance, usability, and efficiency of the EHR system.
* Conduct workflow assessments with operational partners to identify build inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and advance optimization requests through appropriate governance and change management channels.
* Apply cross\-application integration knowledge to identify dependencies and ensure cohesive system performance across modules.


Collaboration and Vendor Engagement:

* Take ownership of defined work streams or components within EHR implementation projects, system upgrades, and other initiatives.
* Coordinate task assignments, track progress, and communicate status to project leads, ensuring deliverables are completed on time and within scope.
* Own ongoing relationships with EHR vendor support, including managing open support requests, evaluating release notes for operational impact, and representing the organization in user group sessions and advisory forums.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams \- including IT, clinicians, administrators, and vendors \- to support EHR initiatives and facilitate effective communication across stakeholder groups.


Documentation and Knowledge Management:

* Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, processes, and procedures.
* Establish knowledge\-sharing practices to ensure critical information is accessible and current across the team.


Training and Mentorship:

* Provide training and mentorship to junior analysts and end\-users, sharing best practices to enhance team capabilities and support continuous professional development.


Compliance and Data Privacy

* Handle all protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations and organizational data privacy and security policies.
* Complete required compliance training and model information security best practices for the team.

  

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

* Excellent analytical, organization, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and within teams.
* Ability to solve complex problems and understand translate customer needs into system solutions.
* Strong understanding of healthcare business process, workflows, and terminology.
* Cross\-application integration knowledge.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity tools.
* Degree in Computer Science, healthcare or related field.

  

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  

* Minimum two (2\) to five (5\) years of experience as an EHR Application Analyst, Health IT Analyst, Epic Analyst, or in a related healthcare information systems role.

  

LICENSURE/CERTIFICATIONS:

  

* Current Epic Certification.

jobs.description:
**Cascade Medical (CM)**, in beautiful downtown Leavenworth in the foothills of the Cascade Mountains, is looking for a full\-time Clinical Informatics Technician. **CM** operates under a strong set of Shared Values, and we are looking for a positive addition to our Quality team.

**Job Summary:**

The Clinical Systems Application Analyst is responsible for the build, configuration, testing, and ongoing maintenance of Cascade Medical's Meditech Expanse clinical applications, including Patient Care, Provider, Ambulatory, Order Management, and Emergency Department Management.


This position translates clinical workflow requirements defined by the clinical informatics team into accurate, tested, and documented system configuration. It is the technical counterpart to clinical informatics: informatics determines what the system should do, and this role determines how it is built and ensures it works.

**Work Schedule:** This is a full time position, exact schedule to be coordinated with the Director of Information Technology and Informatics. Occasional after\-hours or weekend work may be required during system updates or go\-live periods, and onsite support in clinical care settings will be re\-quired. This position can be supported by a remote position working with the the pacific standard time zone.

**Review the job description for full position details**

**To Apply:** Please complete an online application and upload a resume and cover letter of interest with salary requirements.

*As a public entity, our wage range is set on a 30\-step scale (Base\-30 years of experience). Offer letters and wage determination will be written based on years of experience.*
